35941-the-life-of-saint-monica.title: The Life Of Saint Monica
35941-the-life-of-saint-monica.creator: Unknown
35941-the-life-of-saint-monica.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. own for her; because she suffered bravely, forgot herself for others, and remained faithful to her noble ideals, she ruled as a queen amongst those with whom her life was cast. Her influence was great and far-reaching, but she herself was the last to suspect it, the last to desire it, and that was perhaps the secret of its greatness.

58638-rogues-haven.title: _Rogues’ Haven_
58638-rogues-haven.creator: _Roy Bridges_
58638-rogues-haven.description: A book by _Roy Bridges_. Tony had poked a young rabbit into his jacket-pocket; I was carrying a hare in my bag, and we were sneaking homewards through the dusk, when Tim Kerrick, ash-plant in hand, and brace of keepers at heel, stepped out of the coppice.

arxiv-1806-01191.title: Discovery of a radio galaxy at z = 5.72 2018 Discovery of a radio galaxy at z = 5.72 – References
arxiv-1806-01191.creator: A. Saxena, M. Marinello, R. A. Overzier, P. N. Best, H. J. A. Röttgering, K. J. Duncan, I. Prandoni, L. Pentericci, M. Magliocchetti, D. Paris, F. Cusano, F. Marchi, H. T. Intema, G.K. Miley
arxiv-1806-01191.description: Abstract We report the discovery of the most distant radio galaxy to date, TGSS J1530+1049 at a redshift of z = 5.72 z=5.72 , close to the presumed end of the Epoch of Reionisation. The radio galaxy was selected from the TGSS ADR1 survey at 150 MHz for having an ultra-steep spectral index, α 1.

arxiv-2110-10181.title: Spatially Resolved X-ray Study of Supernova Remnant G306.3 − - 0.9 with Unusually High Calcium Abundance ATOMDB ( Smith et al. 2001 ; Foster et al. 2012 ) , CIAO ( Fruscione et al. 2006 , vers. 4.12,) , DS9 ( Joye & Mandel 2003 ) , SAS ( Gabriel et al. 2004 , vers. 16.1.0,) , XSPEC ( Arnaud 1996 , v
arxiv-2110-10181.creator: Jianbin Weng, Ping Zhou, Yang Chen, Shing-Chi Leung, Silvia Toonen, Hagai B. Perets, Ken’ichi Nomoto, Yossef Zenati, Jacco Vink
arxiv-2110-10181.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jianbin Weng, Ping Zhou, Yang Chen, Shing-Chi Leung, Silvia Toonen, Hagai B. Perets, Ken’ichi Nomoto, Yossef Zenati, Jacco Vink. G306.3 − - 0.9 is an asymmetric Galactic supernova remnant (SNR), whose progenitor has been thought to be a Type Ia supernova (SN), but its high Ca abundance appears inconsistent with the Type Ia origin. Hoping to uncover the reason for its asymmetry and the origin of this SNR, we performed a spatially resolved X-ray spectroscopic analysis of XMM- Newton and Chandra observation data.

arxiv-2210-07609.title: Synchronization of Dust Acoustic Waves in a forced Korteweg-de Vries-Burgers model
arxiv-2210-07609.creator: Ajaz Mir, Sanat Tiwari, Abhijit Sen, Chris Crabtree, Gurudas Ganguli, John Goree
arxiv-2210-07609.description: Abstract The synchronization of dust acoustic waves to an external periodic source is studied in the framework of a driven Korteweg-de Vries-Burgers equation that takes into account the appropriate nonlinear and dispersive nature of low frequency waves in a dusty plasma medium.

arxiv-2305-03695.title: Vera : A General-Purpose Plausibility Estimation Model for Commonsense Statements
arxiv-2305-03695.creator: Jiacheng Liu Wenya Wang Dianzhuo Wang Noah A. Smith Yejin Choi Hannaneh Hajishirzi Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science & Engineering, University of WashingtonAllen Institute for Artificial Intelligence Nanyang Technological UniversityJohn A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences, H
arxiv-2305-03695.description: Abstract Today’s language models can be remarkably intelligent yet still produce text that contains trivial commonsense errors. Therefore, we seek a retrospective verification approach that can reflect on the commonsense plausibility of the machine text, and introduce Vera , a general-purpose model that learns to estimate the commonsense plausibility of declarative statements.

arxiv-2306-15480.title: The γ ​ b ​ b ¯ \gamma b\overline{b} production via γ ∗ ​ γ ∗ \gamma^{*}\gamma^{*} collisions at the ILC and LHC
arxiv-2306-15480.description: Abstract Taking into account of the mixing of Higgs-radion in the Randall-Sundrum model and the vector anomalous couplings, we investigate the production of b ​ b ¯ b\overline{b} associated with the photon through γ ∗ ​ γ ∗ \gamma^{*}\gamma^{*} collisions at the International Linear Collider (ILC) and Large Hadron Collider (LHC).

arxiv-2311-06206.title: Parallel Algorithms for Equilevel Predicates Conference: 25th International Conference on Distributed Computing and Networking; January 4–7, 2024; Chennai, India 25th International Conference on Distributed Computing and Networking (ICDCN ’24), January 4–7, 2024, Chennai, India DOI: 10.1145/3631461.
arxiv-2311-06206.creator: Vijay K. Garg, Robert P. Streit
arxiv-2311-06206.description: Abstract . We define a new class of predicates called equilevel predicates on a distributive lattice which eases the analysis of parallel algorithms. Many combinatorial problems such as the vertex cover problem, the bipartite matching problem, and the minimum spanning tree problem can be modeled as detecting an equilevel predicate.

arxiv-2403-06235.title: Probabilistic Neural Circuits
arxiv-2403-06235.creator: Pedro Zuidberg Dos Martires
arxiv-2403-06235.description: Abstract Probabilistic circuits (PCs) have gained prominence in recent years as a versatile framework for discussing probabilistic models that support tractable queries and are yet expressive enough to model complex probability distributions. Nevertheless, tractability comes at a cost: PCs are less expressive than neural networks.

arxiv-2410-05252.title: Causal Micro-Narratives
arxiv-2410-05252.creator: Mourad Heddaya, Qingcheng Zeng, Chenhao Tan, Rob Voigt, Alexander Zentefis
arxiv-2410-05252.description: Abstract We present a novel approach to classify causal micro-narratives from text. These narratives are sentence-level explanations of the cause(s) and/or effect(s) of a target subject. The approach requires only a subject-specific ontology of causes and effects, and we demonstrate it with an application to inflation narratives.

arxiv-2411-05886.title: UnDIVE: Generalized Underwater Video Enhancement Using Generative Priors
arxiv-2411-05886.creator: Suhas Srinath, Aditya Chandrasekar, Hemang Jamadagni, Rajiv Soundararajan, Prathosh A P
arxiv-2411-05886.description: Abstract With the rise of marine exploration, underwater imaging has gained significant attention as a research topic. Underwater video enhancement has become crucial for real-time computer vision tasks in marine exploration. However, most existing methods focus on enhancing individual frames and neglect video temporal dynamics, leading to visually poor enhancements.

arxiv-2511-09623.title: Entanglement, Yang-Mills, and the Scattering Matrix as an SU(N)-equivariant Kernel
arxiv-2511-09623.creator: Kun-Feng Lyu, Rahul Muraleedharan, Kuver Sinha
arxiv-2511-09623.description: Abstract We study two-body scattering as an SU(N)-equivariant map acting on tensor-product representation spaces and analyze the entanglement generated by the S S -matrix. This representation-theoretic perspective separates group structure from dynamics: the decomposition of R ⊗ R ′ R\!\otimes\!R^{\prime} fixes the invariant operator algebra and therefore the qualitative entangling power of the process.

To this end, participants were presented with a series of words and asked to remember the words for a subsequent recognition test. During study, words were presented auditorily with

pmc-10533147.title: Composites and Materials Prepared from Boron Cluster Anions and Carboranes
pmc-10533147.creator: Varvara V Avdeeva, Svetlana E Nikiforova, Elena A Malinina, Igor B Sivaev, Nikolay T Kuznetsov, Nevill Gonzalez Szwacki
pmc-10533147.description: Here, we present composites and materials that can be prepared starting with boron hydride cluster compounds (decaborane, decahydro-closo-decaborate and dodecahydro-closo-dodecaborate anions and carboranes). Recent examples of their utilization as boron protective coatings including using them to synthesize boron carbide, boron nitride, metal borides, metal-containing composites, and neutron shielding materials are discussed.

pmc-10674363.title: Role of Baseline Gut Microbiota on Response to Fiber Intervention in Individuals with Irritable Bowel Syndrome
pmc-10674363.creator: Jerry Zhou, Vincent Ho, Qingsen Shang
pmc-10674363.description: Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is one of the most prevalent functional gut disorders in the world. Partially hydrolyzed guar gum, a low-viscosity soluble fiber, has shown promise in the management of IBS-related symptoms. In this study, we aimed to determine if an individual’s baseline gut microbiota impacted their response to a partially hydrolyzed guar gum intervention.

pmc-11437116.title: Comprehensive input models and machine learning methods to improve permeability prediction
pmc-11437116.creator: Mohammad Ali Davari, Ali Kadkhodaie
pmc-11437116.description: This study investigates the use of machine learning techniques and the proper selection of input data to estimate permeability in geosciences, using six types of input logs: gamma ray (GR), resistivity (RT), effective porosity (PHIE), density (RHO), sonic (DT), and compensated neutron porosity (NPHI).

pmc-11467391.title: HPV16 E6-induced M2 macrophage polarization in the cervical microenvironment via exosomal miR-204-5p
pmc-11467391.creator: Xiaohang Chen, Yanan Liu, Xiaojin Luo, Teng Pan, Tong Zhang, Liang Hu, Buling Wu, Weiqiang Liu, Fengxiang Wei
pmc-11467391.description: The persistent infection of high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) and the progression of cervical cancer necessitate the involvement of microenvironmental immunity. As cervical lesions advance, there is an observed increase in the infiltration of type 2 (M2) macrophages. However, the precise mechanism driving this increased infiltration of M2 macrophages remains unclear.

pmc-11475547.title: Assessing the Relationships between Physical Activity, a Healthy Life, and Personal Happiness in European Union Countries
pmc-11475547.creator: Gabriel Ioan Mangra, Mădălina Giorgiana Mangra, Claudiu George Bocean, Anca Antoaneta Vărzaru
pmc-11475547.description: Background: Maintaining a physically active lifestyle is a determinant factor of a healthy life and personal happiness. Meanwhile, physical inactivity remains a significant issue, resulting in negative consequences for public health. Objectives: This paper investigates the relationships between physical activity, physical inactivity, a healthy life, life expectancy, and personal happiness in European Union (EU) countries.

pmc-11490227.title: Determination of natural populations to be included in breeding program in St. John’s wort species (Hypericum perforatum L.)
pmc-11490227.creator: Fatma Uysal Bayar
pmc-11490227.description: St. John’s wort (Hypericum perforatum L.) is a medicinal and aromatic plant of rapidly increasing importance. The cultural production of this species, which is of economic importance due to its medicinal properties, is limited. One of the main ways to increase production is to develop cultivars. Thus, the homogeneous raw material required for a standard product will be provided.

pmc-11635101.title: A nationwide survey of antimicrobial resistance of Escherichia coli isolated from broiler chickens in Malawi
pmc-11635101.creator: Pilirani Chisembe, Masato Suzuki, Duc Trung Dao, Gilson Njunga, Joseph Nkhoma, Lecollins Mthilakuwili, Ryo Kinoshita-Daitoku, Eisuke Kuroda, Kouji Kimura, Keigo Shibayama
pmc-11635101.description: BackgroundAntimicrobial resistance is a global health challenge with profound implications across sectors. Livestock, a significant field at the One Health interface, lacks sufficient information, particularly in low-resource settings such as Malawi.ObjectivesWe determined the antimicrobial resistance rates of Escherichia coli isolated from broiler chickens in Malawi and explored the relationship between resistance genes across sectors using genomic analysis.

pmc-12429659.title: Evaluating the Predictive Value of Clinical Factors for Pembrolizumab Efficacy and Safety in Advanced NSCLC with High PD-L1 Expression (TPS ≥ 50%)
pmc-12429659.creator: Fedja Djordjevic, Katarina Ljujic, Nemanja Stanic, Neda Nikolic, Ivan Markovic, Jelena Spasic, Shun Lu
pmc-12429659.description: Background: Single-agent pembrolizumab represents a standard of care in the first-line treatment of patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (mNSCLC) with a programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) tumor proportion score (TPS) of ≥50%. Real-world evidence is of increasing importance in oncology, as clinical trial inclusion criteria may not be truly reflective of the patient population seen in daily clinical practice.

pmc-12563614.title: Adenosine Receptors in Neuroinflammation and Neurodegeneration
pmc-12563614.creator: Veronica Salmaso, Silvia Menin, Stefano Moro, Giampiero Spalluto, Stephanie Federico, Stefania Gessi, Trevor W Stone
pmc-12563614.description: Adenosine plays a crucial role in various pathophysiological conditions, including neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration. Neuroinflammation can be either beneficial or detrimental to the central nervous system, depending on the intensity and duration of the inflammatory response. Across a wide range of brain disorders, neuroinflammation contributes to both the onset and progression of disease.

pmc-13052612.title: Mortality and diagnostic practice variation in interstitial lung disease admissions: insights from a multicentre UK cohort study
pmc-13052612.creator: Laura Jane White, Jonathon Shaw, Bethan Powell, Nyan M Kyi, Alicia Sou, Gareth Edward Hughes, Dilanka Tilakaratne, Conal Hayton, Trishala Raj, Vi Truong, Nashwah Ismail, Nawat Khanijoun, Rebecca Huang, Emma Hardy, Zainab Aslam, Mahum Sohail, Mahzaib Babar, Amsal Amjad, Naayaab Khan, Martin Regan, Ob
pmc-13052612.description: BackgroundInterstitial lung diseases (ILDs) are a heterogeneous group of often progressive, unpredictable diseases. They frequently result in hospitalisations secondary to respiratory decompensation, termed ILD-related admissions. A proportion are due to an acute exacerbation of ILD (AEILD). All are associated with high mortality but are poorly characterised in real-world populations.

pmc-13101035.title: Determination of Total Soluble Sugars in Pteridophytes Using the Anthrone Method
pmc-13101035.creator: Pablo Denova‐Lozano, Alejandra Chamorro‐Flores, Amparo B Cerón‐Carpio, Analilia Arroyo‐Becerra
pmc-13101035.description: Sugars serve as crucial integrators of both internal and environmental signals in plants, shaping the regulation of diverse physiological processes that occur throughout the plant's life span, from early embryogenesis to later senescence stages. During evolution, plants have developed various strategies to cope with abiotic stress.
